Reference-set and random-set checks

Ten Cyanorak reference sets (broad stress, nitrogen / phosphorus / iron / light adaptation, photosynthesis), the two failed references from the first iteration (chaperones D.4, oxidative stress D.1.4), and size-matched random sets, tested in every MED4 experiment × timepoint × direction. No hli results.

Heatmap

Cell colour = −log10(BH padj) (saturates at 6), orange for up rows, blue for down rows (BH per gene set across all testable tests). Direction is treatment vs control, as stored in the KG (no light flip): see more_light_arm in the experiment table for which arm got more light. Column labels and hover give both arms and their light levels. Hatched = fewer than 10 genes significant in that direction. Gray = not testable (down, up-only table) or descriptive. Dot = more than 30% of measured genes significant. * = padj < 0.05. Hover a cell for counts and p-values. Static versions: by group, by light level.

Reference behaviour

Per set × scope: testable tests and tests with BH padj < 0.05 by direction (treatment vs control). The light_reading_group scopes split the light experiments by reading (light onset, constant dark vs light, schedule extension, DCMU, phage dark); the old group scope light_onset_photoperiod mixes experiments whose lit arm is the treatment and the control, so its direction_meaning column says not to read direction there. Scopes: experiment group; stress type inside the non-light stress group; for the N / P / Fe adaptation sets, the set's own stress vs other non-light stresses vs all other tests; for ribosomal proteins, the non-light stress tests (frac_sig_down). Counts only.
